paper_name: Scheduling Multi-Periodic Mixed-Criticality DAGs on Multi-Core Architectures
paper_description: Presents MH-MCDAG meta-heuristic for scheduling multi-periodic mixed-criticality DAGs on multi-cores, ensuring MC-correctness with sufficient property for mode switches, and efficient implementation G-ALAP-LLF outperforming literature in acceptance rate.

formal_description.statement: A MC-correct schedule guarantees: 1) Condition LO-Mode: If no vertex of any MC-DAG designated as HI-criticality completes execution by deadlines with LO budgets. 2) Condition HI-Mode: If a TFE occurs, all HI-criticality vertices complete by deadlines with HI budgets.
formal_description.conclusion: Defines correctness for mixed-criticality scheduling respecting deadlines in both modes

informal_sketch.intuition: Ensures safe operation in nominal LO mode and switches to HI mode without missing HI deadlines.
steps: In LO mode, all tasks meet LO WCET deadlines
On TFE, HI tasks get HI WCET, LO degraded, but HI deadlines met

formal_description.statement: MH-MCDAG Meta-heuristic: 1) Compute HI scheduling table using G-ALAP-LLF. 2) Compute LO scheduling respecting Safe Trans. Prop. for HI jobs. 3) Allocate exclusive clusters to heavy DAGs and schedule remaining with heuristic.

variables.G-ALAP-LLF: Global As Late As Possible Least Laxity First
property ensuring HI mode feasibility on switch

formal_description.conclusion: Outlines steps for generating dual scheduling tables per criticality mode

informal_sketch.intuition: Prioritizes HI mode scheduling first, then fits LO while ensuring switch safety.
steps: Schedule HI tasks as late as possible with G-LLF
For LO, insert executions without violating HI reservations
Handle heavy DAGs separately on dedicated cores
informal_sketch.pseudocode:
def mh_mcdag(dag_set, m):
    # Step 1: HI table
    hi_table = g_alap_llf(dag_set.hi_vertices, m)
    # Step 2: LO table with Safe Trans.
    lo_table = compute_lo(hi_table, dag_set.lo_vertices)
    # Step 3: Heavy DAG clusters
    heavy_dags = [dag for dag in dag_set if utilization(dag) > 1]
    for dag in heavy_dags:
        cluster = allocate_cluster(dag, m)
        schedule_heavy(dag, cluster)
    return hi_table, lo_table
key_insights: Safe Trans. Prop. bounds switch overhead
